mapper.insert: INSERT INTO partner (name, business_number, partner_type, contact_name, contact_phone, address, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{businessNumber}, #{partnerType}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{address}, #{active}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, business_number, partner_type, contact_name, contact_phone, address, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM partner ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE partner SET name = #{name}, business_number = #{businessNumber}, partner_type = #{partnerType}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, address = #{address}, is_active = #{active}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
